aCorrectionToThisLanesOwnEarlierReading.whatISaidFirst: At 150 dpi I described it as 'the court's clean hollow box acquiring a second outline inside it'.
aCorrectionToThisLanesOwnEarlierReading.whatItActuallyIs: At 600 dpi it is an INSET PARTIAL RECTANGLE, not a complete second outline: a black vertical bar standing inside the box interior, roughly a sixth of the way in from the right edge, with a black rule along the bottom of the interior. The outer heavy black border and the grey bevel are pixel-identical to the source.
aCorrectionToThisLanesOwnEarlierReading.whichMagnificationSettledIt: 600 dpi. At 150 dpi the mark is real but its shape is not resolvable; the 150 dpi difference is what FOUND it and the 600 dpi crop is what DESCRIBED it. Both renders were pdftoppm -gray of the pinned source and the delivered fixture, cropped to the same 18 x 15 pt window around the widget and magnified 4x for reading.
aCorrectionToThisLanesOwnEarlierReading.whyItIsRecorded: A repair lane that revises its own description should say so rather than quietly restate it, because the second description is the one a later reader will act on.

aCommittedRECORDContradictedByTheseBytes.whatItRecords: It examined these exact two widgets, named them by the same rects, measured 84 added pixels and zero removed, and recorded the result as 'ONE OBSERVATION RECORDED, NOT SCORED AS A DEFECT'.
aCommittedRECORDContradictedByTheseBytes.itsWordsVerbatim: The official form already draws these boxes with a heavy black outer border and a light grey inner bevel; the delivered file draws the same outer border and re-renders the inner bevel a shade heavier on two sides. It is NOT a second box the form does not print, it does not read as a tick - the box interior stays white - and it obscures no printed text.
aCommittedRECORDContradictedByTheseBytes.whatIMeasured: The box interior does NOT stay white. At 600 dpi there is distinct black ink standing inside it: a vertical bar plus a bottom rule, on white ground, inside an UNTICKED notary election box on a sworn affidavit.
aCommittedRECORDContradictedByTheseBytes.howItWasMissed: VF01 states its own method: 'I magnified both renders 8x to see what that is.' Magnifying a coarse render 8x enlarges the pixels, it does not add detail. At the resolution VF01 rendered at, the inner mark and the form's own grey bevel occupy the same few pixels and are not separable, which is exactly what its description reports seeing. Re-rendering at 600 dpi separates them. THE RESOLUTION IS THE WHOLE DIFFERENCE, and the next reader needs to know that: 8x of a 150 dpi render is not 600 dpi.
aCommittedRECORDContradictedByTheseBytes.whatThisDoesNotDo: It does not overturn VF01's verdict on that row and this lane sets no verdict. It records that one observation inside it is contradicted by the bytes, so the observation is not relied on again.

tieringWasWrongHereAndTheNAMEISWHY.whatTheCohortSays: MK_BORDER_COHORT.json / BORDER_COHORT_REMEDIATION.json place this family in tier 'OTHER', with namedControls.JUDICIAL_CONTROL, namedControls.SWORN_OR_DECLARATION and namedControls.SERVICE_RECORD all empty arrays.
tieringWasWrongHereAndTheNAMEISWHY.whyThatIsWrong: The tiering reads field NAMES, and this field is named 'Group2'. The name carries nothing at all. Under Roger's priority order - judicial controls, sworn selections and declarations first - this belongs at the top of the list, not in OTHER.
tieringWasWrongHereAndTheNAMEISWHY.whatSettledIt: Not the name. The census row's effectiveLabel, 'How the notary identified the person who appeared', its policy 'protect', and the page it sits on. A name-based tier cannot see any of those.
tieringWasWrongHereAndTheNAMEISWHY.generalisation: Any family whose form generator emitted positional field names - Group2, Text1, Date_2, all of which this form has - will tier as OTHER however severe its controls are. That is a property of the tiering input, not of the families.

whatWasTriedAndWhyItIsNotShipped.whyFitAppearancesToRectIsNotTheCandidate: fitAppearancesToRect corrects the SCALE of a stream carried through from the source, and it is what closed the analogous Colorado case where an oversized stamp covered the form's own box and produced 80 removed pixels. This is the opposite signature: the outer box is pixel-identical to the source at 0 removed, and NEW ink appears inside it. That is synthesis, not misplacement, and the stream matches no /AP /N in the source by content hash, so there is no carried stream whose placement could be corrected.
whatWasTriedAndWhyItIsNotShipped.whyNoThirdFlagWasGuessed: The remaining candidates change how appearances are generated at a control the packet must never mark, on a notarial certificate. Guessing one and shipping it would put unmeasured ink on a jurat. Closing this needs a reader who can name the shared step that generates that stream; this lane measured it and stopped.

A repair lane holding one family does not move four other families' bytes or invalidate receipts bound to them while their own lanes are mid-rebuild. ri_decriminalized-set and ri_deferred_sentence-set are recorded on FIX59 and FIX05 as RELEASED, and choosing a released grant's destination is a dispatch act, not this lane's.
siblingScopingForWhoeverTakesTheOtherFOU.mechanism: A single boolean on the family's own entry in the FAMILIES table: machineRouteTrailerIsInternalRecordText: true. It is read in exactly one place, by a new helper machineRouteTrailer(route, surface). When the flag is absent or not true the helper returns the old bare `Route: ${route.routeKeys.join(' ; ')}` line verbatim, so the other four families are byte-identical. This was verified, not assumed: only ri_multiple_misdemeanors-set's fixtures changed.
siblingScopingForWhoeverTakesTheOtherFOU.toCoverASibling: Set that one flag on its FAMILIES entry. Nothing else. The four call sites are already switched.
theFourCallSites: proposedOrderBody - passes surface 'filing'. Returns an empty array, so nothing is pushed and the trailer disappears from the proposed order. This is the decisive one: VF02's finding was that packet page 6 is the page carrying the court's findings, the GRANTED and DENIED boxes and the Justice/Judge signature line.
siblingScopingForWhoeverTakesTheOtherFOU.theEASYTHINGTOMISS: TRAILER_LINE inside the composed-PDF layout function was widened from /^Route: / to a RegExp matching either 'Route: ' or the INTERNAL_RECORD_REFERENCE_PREFIX constant. The sole-occupant pull-down keys off that flag: it detects a page whose every drawn row is the trailer and pulls the preceding block down onto it. Without the second alternative the labelled line stops being recognised as a trailer and page 8 of the notice package can go back to being a page of bare identifiers with no heading and no prose - which is the exact defect the pull-down was written to fix. Anyone porting this to a sibling must keep both alternatives.
siblingScopingForWhoeverTakesTheOtherFOU.whatWasDeliberatelyNOTChangedInTheHost: The proposed order's decretal block, ORDER_COURT_BLOCK_NOTICE, the divider, and every empty line OWN-RI-PROPOSED-ORDER-2026-09-05 requires. The markdown guide's own _Route: ..._ footer in participant-instructions.md is untouched: that is the guide, not a filing.
